trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: If we would learn, we would have saved.
trap.right: If we had learned, we would have saved.
trap.why: O brasileiro usa would na if-clause. Comparar: 3º (had + part., would have), 2º (past, would) e misto.

mcq.q: If we had learned, we **___** saved.
If we **___** richer, we would travel.
Misto: If I had slept, I **___** tired now.

opts: If it had rained, we would have stayed.
If it rained, we would stay.

fix.wrong: If we would learned, we saved.
fix.right: If we had learned, we would have saved.

fix.wrong: If I was rich, I would have bought it.
fix.right: If I were rich, I would buy it.

fix.wrong: If she had slept, she isn’t tired now.
fix.right: If she had slept, she wouldn’t be tired now.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o 2º: “If we learn, we save.”
rewrite.answer: If we learned, we would save.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o 3º: “If we learned, we would save.”
rewrite.answer: If we had learned, we would have saved.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o misto: “If I had slept, I wouldn’t have been tired.” (now)
rewrite.answer: If I had slept, I wouldn’t be tired now.
